_comment: PLAMP — the bot for briankeegan's Panel Attack server. GENERATED from a GameCreator training run, do not hand-tune. Weights are for bot/PanelEval.lua and are SHARES: every feature is divided by its own bound before weighting, so a weight is that feature's share of the decision. The divisors live in PanelEval.FEATURES and must match the JavaScript registry they were found under.
_switches: A WEIGHT SET IS ONLY A BOT WHEN PAIRED WITH THE SWITCHES IT WAS FOUND UNDER. Found at depth 2, beam 0 (every candidate expanded), rise on, density off.
_record: 11W 1L of 12 against the best committed peer; 3000 updates across 4 islands.
